projects.title: Sh59.2 million NG-CDF bursary
projects.summary: The largest education allocation in the constituency since NG-CDF began: Sh5,000 per day scholar, Sh6,000 per boarder and Sh10,000 for students boarding outside the county or in colleges.

projects.title: Science laboratory, Waigiri Comprehensive School
projects.summary: A modern laboratory for a school of over 1,000 learners, where science had been taught in a converted classroom. Built mainly for junior secondary learners heading into national exams.

projects.title: Cabro paving for constituency schools
projects.summary: 36 schools identified for cabro paving, with local youth trained through TVET short courses in cabro laying and masonry and given priority for the jobs.

projects.title: Tarmacking of the Mugwandi–Gitumbi–Mungetha road
projects.summary: A road that stalled for years is now being tarmacked, easing the transport of tea and farm produce and creating work for local youth. Speed bumps and signage follow on completion.

projects.title: New roofing and ablution blocks in schools
projects.summary: Modern roofing fitted in 29 of 36 targeted schools, alongside 23 new ablution blocks built through NG-CDF.

projects.title: Rural electrification projects
projects.summary: Working with national government towards power for every homestead in the constituency, with villages and institutions already being connected.

projects.title: Kirima electricity connection
projects.summary: A Sh7.5 million grid connection delivered with REREC in phases, with street lighting planned for security and business.

projects.title: Administration block and science laboratory, Thaita schools
projects.summary: A new administration block at Thaita Secondary School to replace makeshift offices, and a science laboratory for junior secondary learners at Thaita Comprehensive School, both funded by NG-CDF.

projects.title: Science laboratories in primary schools
projects.summary: Laboratories in selected primary schools to support the Competency Based Education curriculum.

projects.title: School dining halls
projects.summary: Kiandieri Secondary dining hall renovated, new halls built at Kiamurunga and Kamuiru secondary schools, and one under construction at Kiringo Secondary.

projects.title: Boreholes for Kerugoya Boys and Kirinyaga Central VTC
projects.summary: Boreholes at Kerugoya Boys High School and Kirinyaga Central Vocational Training Centre in Ngungu to give both institutions a reliable water supply.

projects.title: Renovation of Karaini Primary School
projects.summary: All classrooms renovated (tiling, roofing, painting and windows) and five classrooms added, the start of a facelift planned for all primary and secondary schools in the constituency.

projects.title: Land (Amendment) Bill: Senate amendments
projects.resultLabel: on behalf of the Lands Committee
projects.summary: Moved the motion for consideration of the Senate amendments to the Land (Amendment) Bill (National Assembly Bill No. 40 of 2022) on 7 August 2025, after tabling the committee's report in June.

projects.title: Lands Committee report on the Land Control Bill
projects.summary: Laid the Departmental Committee on Lands report on the Land Control Bill before the House on 15 August 2024.

press.title: Kirinyaga Central MP Gitari hands over modern science laboratory to Waigiri Comprehensive School
press.summary: A Sh4 million NG-CDF laboratory for a school of over 1,000 learners.

press.title: MP Gitari blames political enemies for vandalism of NG-CDF office in Kerugoya
press.summary: The MP recommissions the renovated NG-CDF office in Kerugoya after it was vandalised and looted.

press.title: Needy learners in Kirinyaga Central benefit from KSh59 million bursary
press.summary: The largest education allocation in the constituency since NG-CDF began.

press.title: Sh200m water project to benefit 30,000 Kirinyaga households
press.summary: Gitari backs the Mwea bulk water project and calls on leaders to work together on development.

press.title: Kirinyaga Central to install cabro in 25 schools by December
press.summary: Cabro paving, roofing, ablution blocks, dining halls, labs, boreholes and 28 electrification projects across the constituency.

press.title: Tarmacking of Mugwandi–Thaita road project brings hope to Kirinyaga residents
press.summary: The MP inspects road works in Inoi Ward and opens new facilities at two Thaita schools.

press.title: Over 15,000 students to benefit from Sh59.2 million bursary kitty
press.summary: The MP launches the bursary disbursement and warns against duplicated applications.

press.title: Kirima residents to enjoy power connectivity soon
press.summary: A Sh7.5 million connection for over 200 households in Kanyekiini Ward.

press.title: Stakeholders hail role of NG-CDF in enhancing education
press.summary: Renovations at Karaini Primary and plans for a facelift across all schools in the constituency.

press.title: Kirinyaga set for major road upgrade
press.summary: Gitari presses for the coffee debt waiver and reports progress on last-mile electricity connections.
